class Cache
  def initialize(packer: nil)
    @packer = packer
    @store = {}
  end

  def write(key, payload, stale: false)
    if @packer
      stored_value = @packer.dump([payload, stale])
    else
      stored_value = [payload, stale]
    end
    @store[key] = stored_value
  end

  def read(key)
    stored = @store[key]
    return nil unless stored

    if @packer
      payload, stale = @packer.load(stored)
    else
      payload, stale = stored
    end
    payload
  end

    @store.each do |key, stored_value|
      if @packer
        _, stale = @packer.load(stored_value)
      else
        _, stale = stored_value
      end
      @store.delete(key) if stale
    end
  end

    @store = {}

class Weight
  include Comparable
  attr_reader :amount, :unit

  def initialize(amount, unit)
    @amount = amount
    @unit = unit
  end

  def ==(other)
    other.is_a?(Weight) && unit == other.unit && amount == other.amount
  end

  def <=>(other)
    unless other.is_a?(Weight) && unit == other.unit
      raise ArgumentError, "cannot compare weights with different units"
    end
    amount <=> other.amount
  end
end
